heading_en: Transitional Measures Concerning the Method of Calculating the Capital Floor
summary_ja: 旧告示の承認を受けていた最終指定親会社について、資本フロアの掛目を五年間かけて段階的に引き上げる。
summary_en: For an Ultimate Designated Parent Company approved under the Former Public Notice, the capital floor percentage is phased in over five years.
paragraphs: With respect to the application of Article 13, paragraph (1) of the New Public Notice, for the period until the day on which five years have elapsed from the Application Date, to an Ultimate Designated Parent Company that had received the approval under Article 116 of the Former Public Notice before the Application Date, the words "72.5%" in that paragraph shall be the percentage prescribed in each of the following items according to the period category set out in that item: (i) For one year from the Application Date: 50%; (ii) For one year from the day on which one year has elapsed from the Application Date: 55%; (iii) For one year from the day on which two years have elapsed from the Application Date: 60%; (iv) For one year from the day on which three years have elapsed from the Application Date: 65%; (v) For one year from the day on which four years have elapsed from the Application Date: 70%.
